title: Motion Graphics Designer (2D, 3D & Video)
description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Motion Graphics Designer to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in both 2D and 3D motion design, visual effects, and video editing techniques.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with marketing, content, and product teams to bring concepts to life through dynamic motion graphics.
   

  

 Experience: 2\-5 years
   

  

 Location: Kolkata (Rajarhat\-New Town)
   

  

 Job Type : Work from office
   

  

 ‍
   

  

**Requirements \& Skills**
* Proven knowledge as a Motion Graphics Designer (2D/3D) or in a similar role.
* Strong proficiency in the following software:
* Adobe After Effects (Motion Graphics, VFX)
* Cinema 4D or Blender (3D Asset Creation \+ Motion Graphics)
* Adobe Premiere Pro (Video Editing)
* Adobe Audition (Audio Editing) (Prefferably)
* Adobe Illustrator \& Photoshop (Graphic Design and Asset Creation)
* Understanding of animation principles, kinetic typography, video editing, and sound design.
* Strong attention to detail, creativity, and problem\-solving skills.


 ‍
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and create motion graphics (2D/3D as required) and video content for digital media, advertisements, websites, and presentations.
* Optimize 3D assets and animations for web, social media, and video production.
* Integrate audio editing and mixing to synchronize with motion graphics and video projects.
* Collaborate with designers, editors, and other team members to achieve project objectives.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends in motion graphics and video editing.


 ‍
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Degree in Animation, Motion Graphics, Graphic Design, Multimedia, or a related field.
* Portfolio demonstrating work on branding animations, explainer videos, and promotional content (using both 2D and 3D).
* Experience working with advertising agencies or in the entertainment industry is an advantage.


 ‍
   

  

**Interview Process**
* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Role match \& offer


 ‍
